channel.title: noradz — log
channel.description: Dated notes on what shipped, broke, or changed across Matt's AI builds.

item.title: This log exists now
item.description:
The homepage promised “a working log” before there was one — just a static grid. This page is the fix: short dated entries for the interesting bits (ships, breakages, decisions), a real feed at feed.xml and data/log.json so it's actually followable, and a /now page for what's current.

No build step: entries are edits to data/log.json, the same pattern as the build ledger.

item.title: Scrubber shipped, and the ledger started looking for itself
item.description:
Scrubber — a client-side tool that redacts secrets out of text before it goes into an LLM, then puts them back afterwards — went live at scrubber.noradz.io today, project 05 on the grid.

While it was in, the build ledger tooling learned to scan ~/git for new project repos on its own, instead of waiting to be told about them by name.
